title: MC-Elma Modpack
description: Lightweight Fabric modpack focused on performance, voice chat, building tools, schematics, QoL, and Vanilla+ client improvements.
body:
# MC-Elma Modpack 🍎

MC-Elma Modpack is a lightweight Fabric modpack for Minecraft Java 1.21.10.

It is focused on smoother performance, voice chat support, building tools, quality-of-life improvements, and Vanilla+ client-side visuals.

The pack keeps the game close to Vanilla while making multiplayer, building, and everyday gameplay easier to manage.

### Features

- Performance-focused Fabric mods for better FPS, faster loading, and reduced stutter.
- Simple Voice Chat support for compatible multiplayer servers.
- Building and planning tools such as Litematica.
- Inventory and quality-of-life improvements.
- Vanilla+ visual improvements and OptiFine-like client features.
- Shader support through Iris.
- Included resource pack files and building schematics used for visual setup and construction planning.

### Important Notes

This modpack does **not** include any shader packs.

Iris is included only to provide shader support. Players may install their own shader packs separately.

Some multiplayer features, such as proximity voice chat, require a compatible server-side setup to work correctly.

For best results, allocate **3–4 GB of RAM** in your launcher.
